verdict.rationale: The evidence never documents a daily reconciliation between what Increase's API reports and the balances held at the partner bank, nor any ledger-to-bank-core attestation. The 'reconciliation' material covers a different capability: matching inbound customer payments through unique Account Numbers and correlating returns with their originating transfers. That does not transfer to this platform-to-bank reconciliation story.

support.subject: As a finance lead, the platform ledger reconciles to the bank core — documented daily reconciliation between what the API reports and what the bank holds, the failure that sank Synapse-era programs
